messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-8712 - embeddings-queue burst in us-west (severity: high). 60% of requests are queuing >500ms. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-queue
sara: I'm on call, grabbing it. pulling up metrics and queue logs now.
mike: thanks @sara. FYI autoscaler didn't spin additional workers - looks like a config threshold hit.
sara: log tail: ```ERROR kv_cache eviction backlog=342 avg_enqueue_ms=1200 host=gpu-03```
kevin: I can jump to increase scaling policy if you want; need a safe window to avoid destabilizing other pools.
sara: do it, @kevin. increase desired replicas for embeddings-pool-usw by +2. watch for memory pressure.
oncall-roster-bot: @kevin acknowledged as secondary responder (oncall rotation).
kevin: scaling kicked, `kubectl patch hpa embeddings-pool-usw --patch '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6}}'`
alex: filing customer impact note: several api keys returning 429s, but majority of errors are queue-timeouts. putting FYI to #support.
sara: seeing queue drain from 1.2s -> 380ms after first pod came up. still some 5xx loopbacks to redis. investigating redis shard 2.
mike: pinging infra to check redis shard 2 health — @jen can you confirm?
jen: I see io wait spikes on redis-02, restarting replica to force failover. doing a controlled restart now.
sara: nice. after redis failover redis latency back to normal, queue latency down to ~120ms. errors dropping.
kevin: keeping autoscaler minReplicas until next 15m check. I'll run the validation job to ensure model workers warm caches.
jen: restart complete, replicas are healthy. no new 5xx logged.
oncall-roster-bot: PD-8712 status: acknowledged by sara; escalated to kevin as secondary; incident-bot notes updated.
mike: customer impact: transient 429s for a handful of customers for ~8m. Support notified and alert sent to affected customers.
sara: switching into monitoring mode. I'll post a post-incident note after we confirm stabilization window (30m).
kevin: handoff plan: I'll own stabilization until 14:05z, then hand back to infra rotation if stable. If anything spikes, re-open PD.
alex: adding runbook tweak suggestion: add autoscaler fallback to allow burst for embeddings-pool on queue latency metric (PR incoming).
sara: thanks. closing the immediate loop — no more active alerts for the policy. will update incident tracking ticket with timeline. :white_check_mark:
